description: This source file provides utility functions for parsing, classifying, and managing test project configurations, particularly with Vitest. It handles target path normalization, classification of test files by their purpose, and generates configuration plans for running tests across various modules and extensions in a project.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a given path pattern for consistent path formatting.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks whether a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks whether a given path exists and is a file, relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if a pattern contains glob wildcard characters.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if a filename pattern matches common test file naming conventions (*.test.*, *.spec.*).

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a path, glob, or file pattern based on existence and pattern matching.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts a path argument to a repository-relative normalized path.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Generates an include pattern for test files based on a path argument, suitable for configuration inclusion.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a target path into categories like 'extension', 'channel', 'boundary', etc., based on its path and naming conventions.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Creates an argument array for executing Vitest with specific configurations.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to identify target test files/patterns and flags like watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Generates detailed plans for running tests based on parsed arguments, including configuration files and included patterns.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Creates run specifications, including environment, config, and arguments, for each test plan.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes a JSON file with include patterns for Vitest test inclusion.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Builds argument list for Vitest execution based on parsed command-line inputs.
